source_text: Κἂν ἐπιχειρῶσι τὰ μὲν αὑτῶν σεμνύνειν, τὰ δὲ ἡμέτερα καθαιρεῖν, μὴ σιγῶμεν, μηδὲ πράως φέρωμεν, ἀλλ' ἐκκαλύπτοντες αὐτῶν τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην, ἅπαντα μετὰ πολλῆς τῆς σοφίας καὶ τῆς παῤῥησίας τὰ τῶν Χριστιανῶν ἀνυμνῶμεν· καὶ καθάπερ ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸ διάδημα ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς, οὕτω καὶ ἡμεῖς τὴν ὁμολογίαν πανταχοῦ τῆς πίστεως περιφέρωμεν. Οὐ γὰρ οὕτως ἐκεῖνον ὁ στέφανος, ὡς ἡμᾶς ἡ πίστις καὶ ἡ ταύτης ὁμολογία καλλωπίζειν εἴωθε· μὴ διὰ ῥημάτων δὲ μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ διὰ τῶν πραγμάτων αὐτῶν τοῦτο ποιῶμεν, καὶ βίον ἄξιον τῆς ὁμολογίας διὰ πάντων ἐπιδεικνύμενοι, ἵνα μὴ καταισχύνωμεν τὰ δόγματα ἐν τῇ τῶν ἔργων φαυλότητι, ἀλλὰ διὰ πάντων τὸν Δεσπότην ἡμῶν δοξάζοντες ἀπολαύσωμεν καὶ τῆς ἐνταῦθα καὶ τῆς ἐκεῖ τιμῆς· ἧς γένοιτο πάντας ἡμᾶς ἐπιτυχεῖν, χάριτι καὶ φιλανθρωπίᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, δι' οὗ καὶ μεθ' οὗ τῷ Πατρὶ δόξα, κράτος καὶ τιμὴ, ἅμα τῷ ἁγίῳ καὶ ζωοποιῷ Πνεύματι, νῦν καὶ ἀεὶ, καὶ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων. Ἀμήν.
thought_title: Confess boldly and adorn the confession with a worthy life
orientation: John Chrysostom is closing the homily, exhorting the congregation to answer opponents with bold confession and a life worthy of it, ending in a doxology.
pass_a_gloss: And if they attempt to exalt their own things, and to tear down our things, let us not be silent, nor let us bear it gently, but uncovering their shamefulness, let us praise all the things of the Christians with much wisdom and boldness; and just as the king wears the diadem on his head, so also let us carry around everywhere the confession of the faith. For not so much does the crown adorn him, as the faith and the confession of it are accustomed to adorn us; and let us do this not through words only, but also through the deeds themselves, displaying also a life worthy of the confession through all things, so that we may not put to shame the doctrines in the baseness of our works, but glorifying our Master through all things, may we enjoy both the honor here and the honor there; of which may it come to pass that all of us obtain it, by the grace and love for humanity of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom and with whom to the Father be glory, might and honor, together with the holy and life-giving Spirit, now and always, and to the ages of ages. Amen.

pass_b_english: And if they try to exalt their own ways while tearing down ours, let us not keep silent or bear it mildly. Instead, let us uncover their shamefulness and praise everything that belongs to Christians with great wisdom and boldness. Just as a king wears his diadem on his head, so let us carry the confession of the faith with us everywhere. For that crown does not adorn him as much as the faith and its confession are accustomed to adorn us. Let us do this not only through words but also through our very deeds, displaying in every way a life worthy of the confession, so that we do not put the doctrines to shame by the wickedness of our actions. Instead, glorifying our Master in all things, may we enjoy honor both here and there. May we all attain it, by the grace and love for humanity of our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom and with whom to the Father be glory, power, and honor, together with the Holy and life-giving Spirit, now and always, and to the ages of ages. Amen.
